a_before_b.rationale: Understanding what parameter-efficient finetuning is and how adapter-based techniques like LoRA reduce compute and memory is necessary to meaningfully compare full finetuning and adapter-based finetuning in terms of compute requirements.

b_before_a.rationale: Knowing specific finetuning frameworks such as LLaMA-Factory, PEFT, and Axolotl is not required to define parameter-efficient finetuning or explain how adapter-based techniques work.
